identity.system_name: Quebradas de Asia–Omas y abanicos costeros

notes: ANA identifies Cuenca Omas as official hydrologic unit 1375512; the compound IRFEN candidate still contains local Asia ravines and coastal fans that must be resolved separately.
RD 0312-2022 provides bounded regulatory margin context for Río Omas-Río Chico de Asia and a Río Chico branch; it is not an event footprint, full catchment polygon or observed hydraulic capacity.
The 2016 ANA vulnerable-population map provides named-channel exposure context for Quebrada Río Chico.
INGEMMET 2017 documents affected road/agricultural sites in the Asia-Omas corridor but is not a component-resolved event-day ledger.
COEN-INDECI confirms a huaico in Asia district on 2024-02-06 (record 190014), but the source does not assign it to Río Omas, Río Chico or a specific local ravine.
Geometry and exposure advance only to PARTIAL; historical_events, observations and hydraulic_context remain MISSING.
No negative control, hydraulic capacity, threshold or event-day discharge is inferred from these sources.
Activation remains BLOCKED; decision thresholds and hydraulic factors remain null and operational alerting remains disabled.
